images.caption: U.S. Marine Corps Maj. Isaiah Martinez, left, gives instruction to Capt. Wynndee Young following an attack by enemy forces during a foot patrol exercise at Marine Corps Auxiliary Landing Field Bogue, N.C., Oct. 18, 2012. The Marines, members of a Security Force Assistance Adviser Team, were preparing for an upcoming deployment to Afghanistan. (DoD photo by Sgt. Bobby Yarbrough, U.S. Marine Corps/Released)

images.caption:
Force Reconnaissance Marines with the Maritime Raid Force, 24th Marine Expeditionary Unit perform a diving exit while conducting an initial High Altitude Low Opening jump out of an MV-22B Osprey at Marine Corps Auxiliary Landing Field Bogue Field, N.C., Aug. 11, 2014. Air support for the training was provided by the MEU's Aviation Combat Element, Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron 365 (Reinforced). The training took place as part of pre-deployment training in preparation for the 24th MEUâs deployment at the end of the year. 

(U.S. Marine Corps photo by Cpl. Todd F. Michalek/ Released)

images.caption:
Capt. Craig Freeman, an AV-8B Harrier pilot with Marine Attack Squadron 223, gives the signal for an AV-8B Harrier to take off during carrier qualifications at Marine Corps Auxiliary Landing Field Bogue, Marine Corps Air Station Cherry Point, N.C. June 10, 2013. The pilots conducted simultaneous training operations while beginning readiness for upcoming Marine Expeditionary Unit deployments with the 31st and 22nd Marine Expeditionary Units.

(U.S. Marine Corps photo by Lance Cpl. Glen E. Santy/Released)

images.caption:
Capt. James Slocum calls in an improvised explosive device during a mounted convoy patrol at Marine Corps Auxiliary Landing Field Bogue. Oct. 18, 2012. As a turret gunner, Slocum's job is to detect IEDs. Slocum is a member of a Security Force Assistance Adviser Team (SFAAT) which will deploy to Afghanistan in support of II Marine Expeditionary Force (Forward). 

(U.S. Marine Corps photo by Sgt. Bobby J. Yarbrough)
